purpose: Scaled retrieval diagnostic with distractors; not end-to-end LLM accuracy

splits.dev: cases used for first-period reporting and spot checks
splits.holdout: first scored 2026-10-10; do not retune retrieval against this split after that baseline
splits.hard: harder non-overlap paraphrases that deliberately echo distractor wording

scoring: metric_mrr reciprocal rank of gold executable metric
top1_distractor_rate when top metadata is non-executable
example_hit_at_2 for mode-matched few-shots when expected_mode set
notes: Independent from hr-query-v1 / modes task scores
Hit@K / MRR must not be reported as ask-success rate
hard split is zero-overlap with few-shot examples by construction
